pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed regions of tan pigmentation with smooth edge gradients. Geometry varies from large, complex, branching polygons on the central flank to smaller, more rounded, fragmented shapes on the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial spaces separating the patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate and quadri-radiate. Pathway thickness is variable, generally wider on the upper torso and narrowing toward the leg regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder region, formed by the mane profile against the background.
